name: app-store-changelog
title_zh: 把 git 历史变成给用户看的 App Store
tagline_zh: 别再对着 git log 逐条猜「这条要不要写进 What's New」——它自动筛出用户能感知的改动。
tagline_en: Stop guessing which git commits matter to users. It filters user-facing changes and rewrites them into polished.
desc_en: Create user-facing App Store release notes by collecting and summarizing all user-impacting changes since the last git tag (or a specified ref). Use when asked to generate a comprehensive release changelog, App Store "What's New" text, or release notes based on git history or tags.
why_zh: 不是简单拼接 commit message，而是以「用户视角」过滤重构：只保留影响使用行为的改动。
why_en: It doesn't just concatenate commits—it filters through a user-impact lens, dropping refactors, deps, and CI noise while keeping.
limit_zh: 只认 git 仓库且需有 tag 或指定 ref；产物是英文草稿，不含截图、审核备注或本地化；若提交信息写得含糊。
limit_en: Requires a git repo with tags/refs; output is English draft only—no screenshots, review notes, or localization. Vague commits yield vague notes.
